diagnosis: The original proof repeatedly unpacks bisimilarity into a witness relation and then converts successor pairs back with `le_bisimilarity`. Using bisimilarity’s `follow_fst` and `follow_snd` methods directly removes those existential witnesses, intermediate constructors, and associated elaboration work.
proof_body:
by
  intro h
  use @ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  constructor
  · intro s1' htr
    cases hr with
    | choice h =>
      cases htr with
      | choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨q', htr', h'⟩ := h.follow_fst htr
        exact ⟨q', Tr.choiceL htr', ChoiceBisim.bisim h'⟩
      | choiceR htr =>
        exact ⟨s1', Tr.choiceR htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim HomBisimilarity.refl⟩
    | bisim h =>
      obtain ⟨q', htr', h'⟩ := h.follow_fst htr
      exact ⟨q', htr', ChoiceBisim.bisim h'⟩
  · intro s2' htr
    cases hr with
    | choice h =>
      cases htr with
      | choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨p', htr', h'⟩ := h.follow_snd htr
        exact ⟨p', Tr.choiceL htr', ChoiceBisim.bisim h'⟩
      | choiceR htr =>
        exact ⟨s2', Tr.choiceR htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim HomBisimilarity.refl⟩
    | bisim h =>
      obtain ⟨p', htr', h'⟩ := h.follow_snd htr
      exact ⟨p', htr', ChoiceBisim.bisim h'⟩
